meta.name: add-dial-tool
meta.description: Give chosen NanoClaw agents a real phone number as a container tool — the `dial` CLI baked into the agent image plus OneCLI credential injection for api.getdial.ai, scoped per agent, so the agents you pick can send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive verification codes from inside the sandbox. Independent of the Dial channel; idempotent; re-run to change which agents may use it. Use when the user wants agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat, without wiring Dial as a messaging channel.

copy.tagline: 给选中的代理配上真实电话号码，就能从聊天里发短信、打电话、收验证码。
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想让你手下的代理能直接发短信、打电话或接收验证码。
copy.tagline_en: Give chosen agents a phone number for SMS, calls, and verification codes.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage agents that need to text, call, or receive verification codes.

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会为指定的 NanoClaw 代理配好 dial 工具和凭据，使这些代理能发短信、拨打 AI 语音电话、接收验证码；未选中的代理会被拦截并返回 403。
howto.when: 当你想让某些代理发短信、打电话或从聊天中运行 `dial` 命令，且不需要把 Dial 作为消息通道接入时；也可以用来对已有代理重新授予或撤销该能力。

say.text: 给所有代理开通 Dial，让它们能发短信、打电话和收验证码。
只给 ID 为 ag-sales 的代理开通 Dial，其他保持禁止。
say.note: Claude 会应用该代理的凭据并阻止其他代理。

say.text: 先装好 Dial 但暂时不给任何代理开通。
say.note: 所有代理都会被阻止，之后重跑可再授予权限。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude provisions the chosen NanoClaw agents with the dial tool and credentials, letting them send SMS, make AI voice calls, and receive verification codes. Other agents are blocked (403) from using it.
howto.when_en: Use when you want particular agents to text, call, or run `dial …` from a chat without wiring Dial as a messaging channel; re-run to change which agents have the capability.

say_en.text: Give all agents Dial so they can text, call, and get codes.
say_en.note: Claude lists groups and asks confirmation before applying.

say_en.text: Give Dial only to the agent group ag-sales.
say_en.note: Other agents will be blocked from using Dial.

say_en.text: Install Dial now but block all agents.
